data.name: Mutailib
data.gender_notes: Mutailib is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic 'muta'ala'ba' meaning to provide or to be sufficient. A name of Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) for his son Ismail (Ishmael). The name Mutailib carries the meaning “Well-provided” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mutailib usually hope their child will grow to embody well-provided and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes provision and sufficiency from Allah.
data.etymology: Mutailib belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Well-provided.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mutailib total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: مطلب
in_arabic.meaning: الاسم يعني طالب العلم أو المستطلع للمعرفة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مطلب مشتق من جذر 'طلـب'، ويعني الشخص الذي يطلب العلم أو المعرفة. في السياق الإسلامي، يرتبط هذا الاسم بالسعي وراء المعرفة والفهم، مما يعكس قيمة عالية في الثقافة الإسلامية. استخدم هذا الاسم في التاريخ الإسلامي، مثل مطلب بن أبي طالب، الذي كان شخصية معروفة في عصر النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم.

in_urdu.name: مطلب
in_urdu.meaning: طالب علم یا معلومات کا طالب
in_urdu.long_meaning: مطلب نام کا مطلب ہے علم حاصل کرنے والا یا معلومات کا طالب۔ یہ نام عربی جڑ 'طلب' سے نکلا ہے، جو اسلامی سیاق و سباق میں علم اور معرفت کے حصول کی اہمیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی روایت میں، یہ نام علم اور حکمت کی جستجو کے لئے ایک مثبت صفت کے طور پر دیکھا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुत्तलिब
in_hindi.meaning: ज्ञान का इच्छुक या सीखने की इच्छा रखने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुत्तलिब नाम का अर्थ है ज्ञान की इच्छा रखने वाला या सीखने की आकांक्षा रखने वाला। यह नाम अरबी मूल 'طلب' से आया है, जो इस्लामी परंपरा में ज्ञान और समझ की महत्ता को दर्शाता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम विद्या और ज्ञान की खोज के लिए एक सकारात्मक विशेषता के रूप में देखा जाता है।

in_pashto.name: مطلب
in_pashto.meaning: د پوهې غوښتونکی یا د معلوماتو طالب
in_pashto.long_meaning: مطلب نوم معنی د پوهې غوښتونکی یا د معلوماتو طالب. دا نوم د عربي ريښې 'طلب' څخه اخستل شوی، کوم چې د اسلامي کلتور په سياق کې د پوهې او پوهنې د ترلاسه کولو ارزښت ښيي. د افغان او پښتون دوديزو کې، دا نوم د علم او حکمت د لټون لپاره يو مثبت ځانګړتیا ګڼل کيږي.

in_english.name: Mutailib
in_english.meaning: Seeker of knowledge or one who desires learning
in_english.long_meaning: The name Mutailib originates from the Arabic root 'ṭ-l-b', meaning to seek or request. In an Islamic context, it signifies one who seeks knowledge or learning. Historically, Mutailib is associated with figures such as Mutailib ibn Abi Talib, a companion of Prophet Muhammad. The name embodies the value of pursuing knowledge and understanding, highly esteemed in Islamic tradition.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mutailib is an Arabic name rooted in Islamic history. It is a variation of the Hebrew name Ishmael, which is also the name of the Prophet's elder son in Islamic tradition. The name Mutailib carries an essence of sufficiency and self-sufficiency, which is a desirable characteristic in many cultures, particularly in those with Islamic traditions. It is a reminder of the importance of relying on one’s own resources and not being dependent on external factors for happiness or success.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Mutailib holds deep spiritual significance for Muslims. In Islamic tradition, Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) named his son Isma'il (Ishmael) Mutailib in acknowledgment of God's provision and sufficiency in their lives. The name serves as a constant reminder of God's provision and the importance of trusting in His plan. It is also a reminder of the prophets' faith and reliance on God, inspiring Muslims to cultivate similar traits in their own lives.

historical_references.reference: Mutailib was a prominent companion of the Prophet Muhammad and is most famous for his role in the Battle of Uhud. He is said to have saved the Prophet's life during the battle by shielding him from enemy arrows with his own body.
historical_references.context: The Battle of Uhud took place in 625 AD (3 AH) and was a significant military engagement between the Muslims of Medina and the Meccan army. Mutailib's bravery and self-sacrifice during the battle are widely celebrated in Islamic history.

historical_references.reference: Mutailib was also the father of the Prophet Muhammad's beloved wife, Aisha bint Abu Bakr. She was one of the wives of the Prophet and is known for her historical significance in transmitting Hadith and preserving Islamic traditions.
historical_references.context: Aisha was born around 614 AD (8 AH) and married the Prophet Muhammad in 624 AD (7 AH). Mutailib played an important role in his daughter's upbringing and later became an influential member of the early Islamic community.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Mutailib is of great significance in Islamic culture, being that of the grandfather of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). He is known for his hospitality towards the Prophet when he was an orphan in Mecca. Mutailib's name is a topic of interest on various social media platforms. On Twitter, users often discuss his role in Islamic history and share quotes from Hadiths related to his story. On Reddit, there are various subreddits dedicated to discussing Islamic history and culture, where users often share information and ask questions about figures like Mutailib. On Quora, users ask and answer questions about Islamic history and figures, including Mutailib, with detailed answers and references to Hadiths and other scholarly sources.
